director_intent.rhythm: How the piece breathes across time.
director_intent.camera_language: Lens, camera distance, motion, and shot grammar.
director_intent.editing_language: Cut density, transitions, repetition, silence, and release.
director_intent.music_relationship: How image choices respond to the song.

story_structure.visual_function: Establish world, protagonist, and spatial direction.

continuity_policy.story_assets: Use story frames in sequence unless a render variant explicitly says otherwise.
continuity_policy.reference_policy: References guide generation but are not scanned as video assets.
continuity_policy.effect_policy: Base motion stays restrained; strong effects live inside beat or transition envelopes.
continuity_policy.generation_policy: Final frames cite character reference, environment reference, story beat, and optional camera id.

forbidden_drift: Do not invent new recurring locations without updating the spatial bible.
Do not let visual effects destroy story readability in narrative sections.
